title: chore(spec): re-measure the action:group, action:menu and element:repeater records at the objectui pin and quote their props-read sites, ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR 10 to 13
body:
Fixes #20471

Clause-②: no (docblock text and a gate constant: the accept set and the public type surface are unchanged)

Stage 2 of #20471, as the landing record of stage 1 (PR #22038) scopes it. All six `ComponentPropsMap` rows the card names now quote their props-read site, so this PR closes the card.

The `action:group`, `action:menu` and `element:repeater` records cited objectui lines that did not hold at the pin they assert (`.objectui-sha` = `a58626c88`). This PR re-measures them at the pin, re-points every cited line that moved, corrects the prose that was false at the pin, and then quotes one load-bearing anchor per row. `ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR` goes from 10 to 13.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (docblocks and one code comment, no code):
  - **Section 4b hop note.** It said only the two `objectName` forwards moved at the `0abd4f9f8` → `a58626c88` hop. In fact every container anchor below the deleted `useConfigBagEvaluator()` call moved, and `static-params.ts` moved too. The note now says so. A new "correction" sentence records where earlier hop notes certified anchors that had already drifted (details below). The older dated notes are left as written.
  - **`action:group` and `action:menu` row records:** every moved anchor is re-pointed (table below). The "static values" parenthetical on each member forward now describes what is there at the pin: since objectui#11638, a member's own `properties.params` is no longer read.
  - **`element:repeater` row record:** every `data-list.tsx` anchor is re-pointed (+28), and so are the two `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` anchors. The `fields` sentence said the renderer's TS type and its registration description both advertise `label`. Since objectui#11168 slice 2 neither does, and the sentence now says so.
  - **`element:definition-list` registration prose:** it said the registration publishes the strings `'1'` / `'2'` and marks `items` required. Since objectui#11168 slice 2 it does neither. Both sentences now give the history and the current lines. The inline comment on the `columns` literal makes the same correction. `previews/block-config.ts:307` is re-pointed to `:320`.
  - **`action:button`:** `static-params.ts:91-101` is re-pointed to `:98-108`.
  - **The `[#21855]` member paragraph** above `actionContainerMemberShape` (patch round `00c6b980`, at the seat's direction, claim revision `6027563825`): it called `0abd4f9f8` the current pin. Its three anchors now point at `a58626c88` (group `:325-327`, menu `:261-263`, `static-params.ts:164-174`), in the asserting spelling, so the gate re-checks it at the next pin bump. It is an in-place fix: the same defect class, a mechanical edit, no other claim, and the same gate family.
  - **Three quotes,** one per row, each spelling its path (see "The quotes" below).
- `packages/spec/scripts/check-objectui-pin-citations.ts`: `ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR` goes from 10 to 13, exactly the three quotes. Its docblock names the three. It also updates the worklist count from 418 to 419, as `--verify-anchors` reads it at `a58626c88` (see Acceptance notes for why it went up by one).
- `.changeset/20471-component-row-anchor-requote.md`: a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`, because `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` and these docblocks are published text, as stage 1 measured.

## Re-pointed anchors

- The new line's text was compared with the old line's text at the pin where the old number last held. They are identical for every row except the two `paramsPayload` tails that objectui#11638 rewrote.
- The record's claim was re-read against the new line.

## When each anchor moved

These readings use blob ids of each cited file at every pin from `dd3f7e1be` to `a58626c88`, read in the local objectui object store. `89cad75d5` and `ab1879721` were fetched read-only at depth 1 for this.

- **`action-group.tsx` / `action-menu.tsx`:** objectui#11638 at the `0abd4f9f8` → `a58626c88` hop (+10/-18 and +11/-18). Anchors move -3 below the deleted `useConfigBagEvaluator()` call and -8 (group) / -7 (menu) from the member forward on.
- **`static-params.ts`:** byte-identical from `dd3f7e1be` through `0abd4f9f8`. It gained 7 lines above `readStaticParamValues` at the same hop.
- **`basic/data-list.tsx`:** changed once, at `e420df310` → `31971ff1e` (objectui#11168 slice 2 rewrote both list registrations). The repeater moved by +28. That hop's note does not list the file. Every later note recorded its anchors as held or re-read in place.
- **`previews/block-config.ts`:** `:307` moved to `:320` at the same hop.
- **`data-objectstack/src/index.ts`:**
  - The `translateFilterArray` arm moved at `db11afd49` (+42), at `e420df310` and at `ab1879721`.
  - `serializeOrderBy` moved at `e420df310` (+108).
  - Neither moved at the last hop: the file gained 7 lines at its end.

The new correction sentence in section 4b records the three files whose drift went unrecorded. It does not rewrite the older dated notes.

## The quotes (H3 definition from stage 1: one load-bearing anchor per row, its props-read site)

- `action:group`: `action-group.tsx:325-374` first line `const paramsPayload: ActionDef = Array.isArray(action.params)`. This is the member forward, where every key a member forwards to the runner is enumerated (`type`, `name`, `label`, `description`, `target`, `openIn`, `endpoint`, `method`, params, `bodyExtra`, `bodyShape`, `operation`, `patch`, `confirmText`, `successMessage`, `outcomeMessages`, `errorMessage`, `refreshAfter`, `locations`, `toast`, `resultDialog`, `onSuccess`, `objectName`). The range keeps the record's own extent: from the params payload to the end of the `execute` call. The line is unique in the file, so a drift is relocated.
- `action:menu`: `action-menu.tsx:261-321`, same first line, same role, unique in that file.
- `element:repeater`: `data-list.tsx:125-135`, quoting the opening line of the `readProps` call, the same text stage 1 quoted for the definition list at `:42` (in the source, `const props = readProps` followed by the generic's opening bracket and brace). The type literal is the row's key set. As H3 expected, the line is not unique (`:42`, `:125`), so a drift goes red without a relocation hint.
- **One quote per row, as the claim says.** Stage 1 described the containers' props-read site as "the actions read plus the member forward". The claim and the dispatch both say one quote per row. I chose the member forward because it is where the member key set is read as a set, as the `forwarded: ActionDef` literal is for `action:button`. It also sits below the `actions` read (`:300` / `:335`), so a shift above either line reds the quote. A quote on the `actions` line would add a content check of one key read only. That is noted, not done.
- Each quote spells its path. A path-less continuation inherits the nearest preceding FULL anchor (`inheritedAt` in the gate), which for these rows would be another file.

## Verification (at `afe6f9df`; the patch round `00c6b980` re-ran the card gate, the spec build and tests, and the derived gates green, report `6027887111`)

- **The card's gate, three ways.** All exit codes were captured to a file before any pipe.
  - `OBJECTUI_ROOT=/home/user/objectui … check-objectui-pin-citations.ts --verify-anchors` = exit 0: `13 asserted, 419 objectui anchor(s) still carry no content assertion`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:objectui-pin-citations` beside the objectui checkout = exit 0: `13 anchor content assertion(s) verified against objectui at a58626c88; 500 file:line anchor(s) seen`. The self-test, including its live round-trip, is green.
  - The same with no objectui checkout (the CI shape) = exit 0: `13 … NOT VERIFIED — no git checkout`.
- **Before the floor edit:** the gate was red, exit 1: `You ADDED coverage — set ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR to 13`. All 13 assertions verified, with no mismatch.
- **Ablation, one leg per new quote.** Each leg ran through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with `--verify-anchors` as the wrapped command. Each anchor hit x1. The mutation was proven by a blob change, and the restore by blob == HEAD blob `83976000` with `git diff HEAD` empty. The final porcelain was clean.
  - Leg A, the group range `:325-374` changed to `:326-374`: exit 1, `That line IS in the file — at :325, not :326. Either the anchor drifted by -1 lines`.
  - Leg B, the menu quote `action.params` changed to `action.paramz`: exit 1, `That line is NOWHERE in packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-menu.tsx at this pin`.
  - Leg C, the repeater range `:125-135` changed to `:126-135`: exit 1, `That line appears 2 times in the file (:42, :125)`.
- **Build, typecheck and tests**, all under the shared lock:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0, and `git status` was clean afterwards.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0. `check:scripts-typecheck` compiles the edited script (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 619 passed (619)`, `Tests 18485 passed | 1 todo`. No test names the edited gate script (`git grep`: 0 hits). Its own `--self-test`, including the live round-trip, runs inside the gate.
- **Derived gate families.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` was run with no paths at `afe6f9df` and derived 82 commands, the same list as at `10006d5d`.
  - All 82 were run, with exit codes captured before any pipe. 81 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: about 77 workspace packages unbuilt), so it is NOT MEASURED.
  - That narrowing is declared. This diff moves no emitted JS: the new docblock text has 0 hits in `packages/spec/dist` JS and 2 in `.d.ts`, against a positive control of 14 JS hits for a `.describe()` string. CI runs the gate.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: `82 derived, 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:dts-closure` and `check:exported-any` first refused their prerequisites while a build was in flight. They exited 0 on the final pass, after `pnpm turbo run build` of formula, lint and objectql (14 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0) and the spec rebuild.
  - The `check:pm-dispatch-gates` battery (exit 0, `1976 cases pass`) ran at `10006d5d`. The later commit changes six comment lines in the two spec files and nothing the battery reads.
- **Lint, as a proven narrowing.** `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) is CI's run. Here:
  - Population: the two touched TypeScript files.
  - Count: `npx eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on them reads 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, neither ignored.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, stated at its lines 326-328), so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- **The historical `[#21464]` member docblock** (pin `2e818d0b51ec`) stays dated and unquoted. Its `[#21855]` paragraph, which called `0abd4f9f8` the current pin, was corrected in place in `00c6b980` (see What changed).
- **`data-list.tsx:99-105` is spelled as a full anchor.** It used to be the bare `:82`. A bare continuation there would read as `previews/block-config.ts`. The new full anchor carries no quote, so the worklist count rises from 418 to 419.
- **The repeater quote is not unique in its file** (H3, as stage 1's review judged acceptable).
- **Stage 1's changeset** (`.changeset/20471-component-row-anchor-quotes.md`, not yet released) says the other three rows "carry no quote yet". This PR adds its own changeset rather than editing that one.
